description: The recovery signal turned into exactly one project fact naming the prerequisite, with the misleading symptom attached so the next agent recognises it.

add.body: `npm run test:e2e` needs `docker compose up -d` to have run first; the suite starts no containers of its own and the failure it produces points at the test, not at the missing stack.
The e2e suite assumes the compose stack is already up: run `docker compose up -d` before `npm run test:e2e` or it fails with an error that reads like a broken spec.
Prerequisite for `npm run test:e2e`: `docker compose up -d`. Nothing in the repo states it and the resulting failure is misleading.
